observations.outcome_window: Symptom onset after the training. Exact onset interval, time to first assessment and post-treatment follow-up are unreported.
observations.note: The 26-year-old woman reported air hunger. ECG showed sinus tachycardia and arterial blood gas showed hypoxia, hypocarbia and mild respiratory alkalosis. CT angiography did not show pulmonary thromboembolism. The team treated provisional DCS with hyperbaric oxygen and considered the diagnosis confirmed after symptoms resolved. The authors attributed inadequate denitrogenation to mask fit on case review. Delivered FiO2 and the exposure denominator are unavailable.

cohort_checks.evidence: Shared authors. The register reports zero events among 79 female trainees. Incident date, site and participant role are unavailable.
The published cluster describes three male patients with limb pain during descent. The Dak report concerns a woman with air hunger after training.
